ToolAnnotations.description: Advisory UI hints only; hosts must not use these fields as authorization decisions.

ToolInvocation.description: Provider-neutral client-safe tool-call envelope with one canonical input and one canonical outcome. Lifecycle remains ConversationItem.status.

position.description: Provider-defined ordering position. Read-only in Project v1 operations.

ProviderId.description: Opaque identity of one Gateway provider.

UsageTimeRange.description: Half-open [from,to), from < to. Calendar validity and supported bucket alignment are validated by Provider.

UsageFilter.description: Absent modelIds selects all; empty modelIds is invalid. Unknown models are included by default only without a model filter.

UsageAggregation.description: IANA timezone; sum additive metrics. Unsupported grouping, precision or timezone must return unsupported_usage_query, never silently coarsen or prorate.

UsagePage.description: Default limit 100. Cursor binds exact query, source scope and immutable revision. Expired revisions return usage_cursor_expired.

UsageQuery.description: Filter before aggregation and pagination. Summaries cover every filtered record, never just a page. Defaults sort bucketStart then modelId ascending, unknown model first. Metric sorts require that metric. Group summaries require model grouping. PeakDaily uses totalTokens per calendar day, ties select earliest date; all-time means available dataset history, not account lifetime.

UsageValues.description: Return exactly requested metrics. Input includes cache read/write; total = input + output. Cache is not added twice. Missing metrics are null/unknown; incomplete sums are partial.

UsageCoverage.description: Completeness is relative to dataset scope. Missing buckets are not zero unless coverage establishes completeness.

UsageDataset.description: timeZones empty means any supported IANA timezone; otherwise only listed zones. Capability is about available source data, not UI preferences.

UsageNativeAccountSummary.description: Unfiltered native account facts, independent of query filters and daily bucket retention. Never combine with local observed totals.
